reason: The README describes a read_graph tool that analyzes workspace structure, exported symbols, imports, dependents, and unused imports using an in-memory codebase knowledge graph.

summaries.zh: 通过构建代码库知识图谱，查询工作区的目录结构、导出符号、导入关系、依赖项和未使用的导入。
summaries.en: Builds an in-memory codebase knowledge graph for querying workspace structure, exported symbols, imports, dependents, and unused imports.

capabilities: Reads workspace files and directories to build an in-memory codebase graph
Parses TypeScript, JavaScript, and Python symbols and import relationships
Provides structural and dependency queries through a read_graph tool
